en_US.title: Hyatt Hotels and Resorts in the Chinese Mainland

destinationData.body:
From grand cities to waterfront escapes, find your perfect getaway.

Trek across the Great Wall of China. Stroll along the Bund waterway. Build your China adventure.

Take your pick from luxurious hotels in Beijing or cosmopolitan suites in Shanghai, and trips that take you from the idyllic beach town of Sanya to the electric city of Guangzhou. Immerse yourself in each of these adventures—and more—during your stay at Hyatt hotels and resorts in China.
destinationData.headline:
Hyatt Hotels and Resorts
in the Chinese Mainland
destinationData.metaDescription: Discover all the hotels and resorts that Hyatt has to offer in the Chinese Mainland. From Beijing to Shanghai to Sanya and more, our World of Hyatt has you covered.
destinationData.pageTitle: Hyatt Hotels and Resorts in the Chinese Mainland

zh_CN.title: 中国大陆地区凯悦酒店及度假村

destinationData.body:
从摩登都市到海滨胜地，总有一个地方是您的心之所向。

寻访长城古韵，感受外滩脉动，谱写属于您的多彩中国大陆地区之旅。

北京的奢华气派，上海的精致摩登，三亚的闲逸海滨，还有广州的多元活力——欢迎入住凯悦酒店及度假村，发现不止于此的精彩中国大陆地区。
